{{Top|leg}}
'''Gyntal''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[Hound-W2 SPD]], Gyntal relayed information that a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] used the droid to search his [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] after augmenting his organic security force with the units.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
